name: godot-gut-test-provider
description: VS Code Test Explorer integration for the third-party Godot Unit Test (GUT) add-on.

commands.title: GUT Test Explorer: Export Last Failure Report

gutTestProvider.godotPath.description: Optional Godot executable path. Defaults to the GUT extension override or Godot Tools path.

gutTestProvider.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time allowed for a non-debug GUT test invocation.

gutTestProvider.repeatFailedCount.description: Number of attempts made by the Repeat Failed profile.

gutTestProvider.breakOnFailure.description: Pause the Debug profile at GUT's first assertion failure.

gutTestProvider.breakOnEveryFailure.description: Keep the automatic GUT failure breakpoint active after the first hit.

gutTestProvider.openFailureLocation.description: Open the project source location when the debugger pauses on a GUT failure or Godot runtime error.

gutTestProvider.stopOnErrors.description: Report and navigate to Godot runtime errors when the debugger pauses for an exception.

gutTestProvider.additionalArguments.description: Additional Godot or GUT command-line arguments for each run.

gutTestProvider.environment.description: Environment variables applied to the Godot process.
